name: Segawa Akino
source:
Akira’s mother. She lost her husband while raising her young son, and has since managed to balance work and raising him on her own. And yet, for some reason, she is almost always mistaken for being younger than her son.

She has a rather unconventional way of thinking, and seems largely unfazed by her son’s illness. However, she has a kind heart and cherishes her only son, Akira, more than anyone else.

[From [url=https://syrup-soft.com/hs/chuforyou/chara.html#akino]official site[/url]]
